Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. Attaching our standard DPA and the current subprocessors export. Quick notes up front:

- We can execute via DocuSign (preferred) or AdobeSign; DocuSign typically gives us faster turnaround for enterprise accounts.
- For transfers from EU to US we rely on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and a Privacy Annex where required; we can include the SCCs in the DocuSign envelope.
- The attached subprocessors CSV includes region and role; if Atlas needs a more detailed dataflow map we can run that as a short follow-up.

Questions for your team:
1) Do you need any additional controls around KMS or customer-managed keys for secrets?
2) Any data residency constraints (EU-only, or specific cloud regions)?

I've looped in Laura (Legal) and Marissa (Privacy/onboarding) to help with any redlines and to confirm e-sign routing.

Next steps: Please confirm e-sign preference and whether Atlas will be sending redlines or prefer we start with our template for your legal to mark up.

Best,

Hi — Laura from Redwood Legal here. Thanks for the pass and for being specific — that helps. Quick responses to your bullets:

- Subprocessor notice: we typically provide a 30-day notice window for new subprocessors; for categories you consider high risk we can agree to an extended notice and a whitelist process. Can you indicate which categories you want to be treated as high risk?
- Audit artifacts: we can commit to producing requested artifacts within 45 days for most standard requests; for forensic-level requests we may need to align on scope and potentially an on-site or secure remote review.
- SCCs: we will include the latest EU SCCs in the execution package. We'll also attach our Data Processing Annex which maps roles and transfer mechanisms.

We prefer to route execution via DocuSign. If Atlas provides a DocuSign sending address we can set up a co-sign flow so your legal executes first and we countersign. Otherwise we can initiate from our DocuSign account and add Atlas as signer.

Looping Marissa for onboarding questions — Marissa, can you confirm whether we need to produce a more detailed in-scope dataflow for Atlas' privacy team?

Regards,
Laura Bennett
